purpose: Explain why the 100 VU average stays above 20 ms after query/index tuning; record likes_desc cost (outside the fixed measurement request)
state: step 4 final code (IN + GROUP BY) with step 3 indexes, same seed

method.app: bootJar of HEAD, local profile, server 18081, management 18082, show-sql off
method.runs: run A (diagnosis 1): protocol 100 VU x 1,000 right after start, then 1 VU x 5,000 and 100 VU x 50,000 with CPU and Hikari gauges; run B (diagnosis 2): app restart, 1 VU x 5,000 warmup (not recorded), then 1 VU x 5,000 and 100 VU x 50,000 with Performance Schema digest and Hikari timers
method.cpu: app = ps cputime delta, mysql = container cgroup usage_usec delta, k6 = /usr/bin/time user+sys
method.note: longer runs than the 1,000-sample protocol are used only for diagnosis
